messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must each Member State designate the notifying authority required by Article 27 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Entro quale data ciascuno Stato membro deve designare l'autorità notificante richiesta dall'articolo 27 del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
